content: The test image shows a very young soybean seedling completely collapsed/wilted at the soil line on sandy soil. Leaves are brown, curled, and dead. Classic damping-off symptom pattern. Top candidates: Pythium_damping_off, Rhizoctonia, Phytophthora.

**Analysis:**
- **Test image**: Very young soybean seedling (cotyledon stage) completely collapsed at/near the soil line on sandy soil. Leaves are curled, brown, and dead. Classic post-emergence damping-off pattern.
- **Pythium_damping_off**: Reference shows the same early seedling stage collapsing at soil line, watersoaked appearance — strong match.
- **Rhizoctonia**: Shows more distinct reddish-brown sunken lesions on the hypocotyl, less complete collapse of very young seedlings.
- **Phytophthora**: Tends to affect older plants with stem canker and brown discoloration higher up the stem.
